$comment: Default field values for the 'public-web' security profile. Technically identical to 'internal' today — the difference profiles.md describes is review scrutiny and audience framing, not a different technical baseline, since both are static GitHub Pages apps. If that changes (e.g. a public-web app gains a real backend), this file should diverge from internal.json rather than staying a copy.

contentTypeOptions.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

permissionsPolicy.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

frameProtection.notes: Requires a header (X-Frame-Options) or a directive meta-delivered CSP ignores (frame-ancestors); neither is available on GitHub Pages.
